title: BTC/ETH: do AIVIX factors add information?
intro: Verified hourly prices, a fixed linear experiment and pre-outcome observation receipts. Historical factor availability remains unverified.

findings.no_prior_skill: None of the learned screens improves mean fold MSE over the fit-only mean prior.
findings.mixed_screen: The measured screens have mixed prediction results; independent evidence remains incomplete.

factorWorse: In this snapshot, all factor-augmented arms also have worse mean fold MSE skill than price-only Ridge.
factorMixed: Compare factor and price-only loss on the same dates; historical timing assumptions still limit interpretation.
flatNote: The fixed 20bp prediction hurdle leaves most learned rules in cash. Zero median return is not evidence of a profitable or well-calibrated model. The full fold table retains rare trades and losses.
priceScope: {hours} verified 1h bars and {four} derived 4h bars per asset; BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT, raw USDT prices.
factorScope: {rows} daily observations, two assets and three indicator IDs. A daily factor is not an hourly factor.
factorAvailability: Historical first publication and revision policy have not been independently verified. Indicator definitions are not yet independently confirmed; these are factor-augmentation tests, not established sentiment alpha.
methodTitle: One fixed question, four learned arms
method: Ridge with fit-only feature/target scaling, seven price/asset features and three expanding folds. Compare price-only with daily-factor proxies available 24h, 72h or 192h after period end, on the same sample intersection. The 192h control shifts the 24h proxy by another seven days. No threshold or parameter search.
timing: Completed features at t → one full-bar delay → entry open at t + one bar → exit open at t + two bars. Fit labels are purged before the first test decision.
accounts: Each fold starts in cash. Two equally initialized asset sleeves use fractional long/cash positions, with initial and terminal trading fees. Fees are 0/10/25bp one-way. Separate folds are not joined into a continuous portfolio.
scoreNote: Return is the median across folds; skill/exposure/turnover are fold means, and drawdown is the worst fold. Rule controls have no return-prediction loss. Rank correlation is within each asset over time, not a broad cross-sectional stock ranking. Holding share counts invested asset-bars with equal asset weights; turnover is averaged after asset-level normalization. Portfolio return and drawdown use combined equally initialized sleeve NAVs.
chartError: The chart could not load. All measured facts remain in the tables.
chartNote: Charts load on request. Net-return comparisons show all three one-way fees; other metrics use the same 10bp cases. Null loss metrics for rule controls remain missing.
foldNote: Three non-overlapping test windows: April–May, June–July and August–September 2026. Final signals requiring unavailable exit opens are excluded; no missing bars are filled.
uncertainty: Seven-day time-block bootstrap, 2,000 fixed-seed draws, preserving fold boundaries and asset pairing. These are retrospective, unadjusted intervals; unequal exposures and unverified factor timing limit inference.
futureTitle: A forward record that distinguishes commitments from outcomes
futureNote: Counts below are an immutable publication snapshot, not a live stream. Warmup bars are not new timely observations. Forecasts are committed before modeled future entry and scored only after later outcome bars arrive.
unscored: No scored forecasts are recorded in this snapshot. Forward performance cannot yet be assessed.
scoredLimit: Self-recorded forecast scores still require independent review; they are not a registered independent holdout or execution evidence.
factorBlocked: Real-time factor forecasting remains blocked: the retained daily snapshot is stale and historical availability is unverified.
